subject: Re: Kickoff: cross-dataset label harmonization — sweep week + closing decisions
body:
Team,

Quick decisions as the validation sweep spins up this week on our cirrus allocation:

1) Kaia's 5 corrected rows are in; the sweep runs against the corrected mappings only. We are not maintaining a "paper-faithful" variant — the corrected CSVs become the canonical Corpus copy, with a changelog note.
2) Direction-aware query mode ships with the sweep results. Symmetric mode stays available but logs a deprecation warning, per Linnea's suggestion.
3) Scope cut: the fourth dataset pair we floated in April (adding the drive-scene set) is out of this window. It goes to the Q3 list — OKRs are locking Friday and I'd rather commit to what's running now.

If the sweep confirms the +1.8 mIoU pattern holds across all three pairs, we present at the Jul 2 review and close on schedule.

Dmitri
